name: Beef gyudon donburi
steps: Simmer thinly sliced onion in dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and a little sugar.
Add the thin-sliced beef and cook until no longer pink.
Let the broth reduce slightly to concentrate the flavour.
Spoon the beef and onion over a bowl of hot rice.
Ladle a little broth on top and add pickled ginger if you like.
